atomic_qas.question: Why treat maintenance as a public-interest concern?
atomic_qas.answer: A service is useful only while someone can repair it. Reliability depends on ordinary care, not a dramatic launch.

atomic_qas.question: How do you uncover fragile knowledge?
atomic_qas.answer: I ask someone new to perform a routine task from the notes. Every private explanation marks knowledge the service has not retained.

atomic_qas.question: What improvement would you make next?
atomic_qas.answer: I would place short operational notes beside each recurring task. A real handoff will test whether those notes are enough.
